rationale: C07 plausibly supplied concrete national-forest boundary and reservation machinery used in the child: extension or definition of exterior boundaries, immediate reservation of federally acquired lands as parts of the respective forests, and automatic reservation of lands acquired later upon acquisition of title. C22 closely parallels the latter two provisions but lacks the same boundary-redefinition sequence. C11 uses similar present-ownership/future-acquisition machinery for a national park, making it a weaker cross-domain analogue.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the exterior boundaries of the aforementioned national forests shall be located and defined as set forth in the descriptions
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The exterior boundaries of the Chequamegon National Forest are hereby extended to include the following-described area
shared_material.explanation: Both directives first establish or revise exterior national-forest boundaries through attached land descriptions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all national-forest lands within those boundaries are hereby reserved as parts of the respective national forests within which they are located
shared_material.parent_excerpt: all lands within such area which have been acquired ... are hereby added to and reserved as parts of the Chequamegon National Forest
shared_material.explanation: The operative provisions use substantially the same machinery to reserve existing federal lands inside the newly specified boundaries as parts of the forest.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all lands within those boundaries which may hereafter be acquired by the United States for national-forest purposes shall, upon acquisition of title thereto, be reserved as parts of the respective national forests within which they are located
shared_material.parent_excerpt: all such lands hereafter acquired by the United States under such authority shall likewise be added to and reserved as parts of the said forest immediately upon acquisition of title thereto by the United States
shared_material.explanation: This is a distinctive parallel automatic-reservation clause for future acquisitions, with nearly identical triggering language based on acquisition of title.
